diagnostics.message: The ordinary lintel transfers the bath-beam reaction plus explicit wall/floor/roof challenges to the existing side-pier axes. Its bolted joint, pier bearings, genuine arch and ground receivers remain unqualified.

Actual flight/landing gravity and transfer reactions are derived. Precast reinforcement/end profiles, bearings, bolted joints, post stability/base, guard upstands and full headroom remain unqualified.
The midlanding, window sill and guard base move by half the floor-datum change; the window head is retained. The source guard mounting does not transfer to the lower steel sill.
The wet-wall beam and stair trimmer meet at one receiving wall. Their combined reaction and eccentricity must be designed together; separate nominal pad pressures are not independent capacities.
Inherited RC field rectangles are geometric span references, not a precast unit schedule. Bridge, residual strips, wall heads, cuts and actual bearing edges remain explicit design work.
Section classification, lateral torsional buckling, erection torsion/restraint, connections, concentrated bearing, diaphragm/ties, fire and installed materials have not been qualified.
This changed floor and upper datum do not adopt or regenerate the occupied house, foundation reactions, roof, stair headroom, openings or services.
